$comment: Layer 13 WP-13.3 `bash` canonical shape, discriminated by a top-level `builtin_bash` key -- another schema for conformance/agent/'s own directory. A runner creates a fresh temporary working directory, constructs the real `bash` tool over the real local ctx.fs and ctx.subprocess (the host's own shell: Git Bash on Windows, /bin/bash on POSIX), and runs the case through the real Layer 06 execute pipeline. Expectations are generated from the pinned-Pi bash_probe outputs (minion-agent-docs assurance/layers/data/13-wp133/out/pi-{win32,linux}.json) and keyed by host platform; a host whose platform has no expectation skips the case. Normalization, never behaviour: in the result text and details, the full-output file's path becomes `<FULL_OUTPUT>` and the working directory becomes `<CWD>`.

oneOf.$comment: JSON has no non-finite numbers; the runner passes the binary64 value

signal.$comment: aborted before the call: Layer 06 preflight answers it

abort_after_ms.$comment: the runner aborts the call's signal this long after starting it

missing_cwd.$comment: the provider's cwd is a non-existent child of the temporary directory

validation_rejected.$comment: Layer 06 argument validation rejected the call before execute (L0506-D001: a declared number is finite-only). The validator's text is binding-specific (TOOL-003), so each runner checks its own validator's rejection

text_length.$comment: UTF-16 code units, as Pi's `length` (a text over 4000 units is recorded by length, head and tail, as the pinned probe records it)

text_head.$comment: the first 200 UTF-16 code units, exact

text_tail.$comment: the last 400 UTF-16 code units, exact

oneOf.$comment: no truncation details (Pi: undefined; error results carry {})

truncation.$comment: Pi's TruncationResult without `content`; the runner checks `content` separately: it is the text before the notice

oneOf.$comment: the file's raw bytes; its name is minion-bash-<unique>.log in the provider's temporary area
